data.title: Tom Lee’s Bitmine Buys More Ethereum, Adds to Stock Buyback
data.description: The crypto treasury company says it added another 10,399 ETH last week, bringing its holdings to nearly 5.8 million ETH as it pushes toward its goal of owning 5% of Ethereum's circulating supply.
data.keywords: Ethereum, Tom Lee, Bitmine Immersion Technologies
